name: Aberrant Dragonmark
summary: A dragonmark-themed feat that increases Constitution, grants a sorcerer cantrip, grants a 1st-level sorcerer spell cast through the mark, and adds a Hit Die-based random effect when that spell is cast.

ability_score_increases.raw_text: Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

granted_spells.raw_text: In addition, choose a 1st-level spell from the sorcerer spell list. You learn that spell and can cast it through your mark. Once you cast it, you must finish a short or long rest before you can cast it again through the mark. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

granted_cantrips.raw_text: You learn a cantrip of your choice from the sorcerer spell list.

granted_features.name: Aberrant Mark Spell Surge
granted_features.description: When the 1st-level spell is cast through the mark, the character can expend and roll one Hit Die. An even roll grants temporary hit points equal to the roll. An odd roll deals force damage equal to the roll to a random creature within 30 feet, excluding the character; if no other creatures are in range, the character takes the damage.

granted_features.raw_text: When you cast the 1st-level spell through your mark, you can expend one of your Hit Dice and roll it. If you roll an even number, you gain a number of temporary hit points equal to the number rolled. If you roll an odd number, one random creature within 30 feet of you (not including you) takes force damage equal to the number rolled. If no other creatures are in range, you take the damage.

granted_features.name: Aberrant Dragonmark Flaw
granted_features.description: The character develops a random flaw from the Aberrant Dragonmark Flaws table.
granted_features.raw_text: You also develop a random flaw from the Aberrant Dragonmark Flaws table.

limited_use_features.trigger: After casting the chosen 1st-level spell through the mark
limited_use_features.effect: The spell cannot be cast again through the mark until the character finishes a short or long rest.
limited_use_features.raw_text: Once you cast it, you must finish a short or long rest before you can cast it again through the mark.

optional_rules.name: Greater Aberrant Powers
optional_rules.trigger: Upon reaching 10th level, at the DM's option
optional_rules.effect: The character has a 10 percent chance of gaining an Epic Boon. If the character fails to gain a boon, they have a 10 percent chance the next time they gain a level.
optional_rules.risk_or_cost: If the character gains a boon, they permanently lose one Hit Die and their hit point maximum is reduced by a roll of that die plus their Constitution modifier, minimum reduction of 1. This reduction can't be reversed by any means.
optional_rules.raw_text: At the DM's option, a character who has the Aberrant Dragonmark feat has a chance of manifesting greater power. Upon reaching 10th level, such a character has a 10 percent chance of gaining an Epic Boon from among the options in chapter 7 of the Dungeon Master's Guide. If the character fails to gain a boon, they have a 10 percent chance the next time they gain a level. If the character gains a boon, the DM chooses it or determines it randomly. The character also permanently loses one of their Hit Dice, and their hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to a roll of that die plus their Constitution modifier (minimum reduction of 1). This reduction can't be reversed by any means.
